activeRecallQuiz.scenario: A stock crosses above its 50-day SMA by just 0.2% on Monday during a 3-week sideways range, then closes below on Tuesday. What filter would have saved you from this whipsaw?
activeRecallQuiz.question: A stock crosses above its 50-day SMA by just 0.2% on Monday during a 3-week sideways range, then closes below on Tuesday. What filter would have saved you from this whipsaw?
activeRecallQuiz.correctAnswer: Price Filter (demanding a 1-3% penetration margin) and Time Filter (requiring at least 2 consecutive closes beyond the MA) would have completely filtered out this single-day whipsaw.
activeRecallQuiz.explanation: Applying grounded principles prevents catastrophic losses and capital depletion.

coreTakeaways: Always evaluate underlying market assumptions before entering positions.
Separate gross theoretical payoff from real-world net profit.
Follow disciplined risk and position sizing limits on every trade.
